g.text: Place the shorter string in columns; keep two arrays of min(n, m) + 1 integers.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526575

g.text: Returns the length only. Input strings use additional O(n + m) storage; reconstruction needs another design.
